explanation: Compared against Written on the Wall II (archived all.html via the Wayback Machine), Conjecture 7 (status T, proved by DeLaVina, Fajtlowicz and Waller 2002): 'If G is a simple connected graph, then L_s(G) ≥ maximum of l(v) − 1 + n − 2α(G)', with L_s the maximum number of leaves of a spanning tree and l(v) the local independence number. The Lean statement for connected G on a finite nontrivial type: max_v indepNeighborsCard G v − 1 + n − 2·indepNum G ≤ Ls G, computed in ℤ/ℝ (no truncation), with Ls the sSup over spanning trees of the number of degree-1 vertices. Direct transcription. Faithful.
